title: A Deligne complex for virtual Artin groups
summary: Virtual Artin groups were recently introduced by Bellingeri-Paris-Thiel as a generalisation of virtual braid groups. In this article, we initiate a geometric study of these groups by constructing an analogue of the Deligne complex for virtual Artin groups, and we prove that it is CAT(0) for all locally reducible defining graphs (a class that contains in particular two-dimensional graphs and graphs without any label $3$, and which is generic in the sense of Goldsborough-Vaskou).
